name: @bjornpagen/grizzle-openapi
description: A login's OpenAPI 3.2 document, the one owner of its format: its writer, which reads a login's served file and whose text `grizzle generate` writes as openapi/<login>.json and `grizzle check` compares, and its reader, a client's reading of the login's wire back from it (x-grizzle-wire), browser-safe
author: Bjorn Pagen <11238136+bjornpagen@users.noreply.github.com>
